newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Smart, Globe sign interconnection pact.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Smart, Globe sign interconnection pact.

text.p: Smart Communcations Inc, the phone unit of holding firm Metro Pacific Corp (MPC), said on Tuesday it has signed an agreement to interconnect its network with Globe Telecom GMCR Inc.
The two companies have agreed to link their mobile telephone system, local exchange carrier, inter-exchange carrier, paging and international phone gateway facilities, Smart said in a statement.
"As a result, direct links are now possible between Smart cellphone subscribers and Globe's Handyphone subscribers," it added.
Globe is a unit of Philippine conglomerate Ayala Corp and Singapore Telecommunications Ltd.
